d:
Koi Dheere Dheere/Athey Thooa Lareya in Punjabi translates to a love bite from a wasp gone wrong.
‘Raula’ means ‘Dhoom’, chaos or noise that is made when the arrival of a King is being announced. The King of Bhangra returns after a hiatus of three years with eleven electrifying tracks in album ‘Raula Pai Gaya’. Mehndi shows his true mettle as composer, lyric writer and singer in his album.
